section.p: Consider a status indicator lights table under the heading "Status Indicator Lights". The table has three columns — Light Pattern, Color, and Status — with a header row using <th> elements and data rows using <td> elements. No merged cells exist.

entry.codeblock:
Status Indicator Lights

Light Pattern Color Status
Solid Green Printer is ready.
Flashing Orange Paper jam detected.
Solid Red Ink level is critically low.

<reference id="status_indicator_lights"> <title>Status Indicator Lights</title> <refbody> <simpletable> <sthead> <stentry>Light Pattern</stentry> <stentry>Color</stentry> <stentry>Status</stentry> </sthead> <strow> <stentry>Solid</stentry> <stentry>Green</stentry> <stentry>Printer is ready.</stentry> </strow> <strow> <stentry>Flashing</stentry> <stentry>Orange</stentry> <stentry>Paper jam detected.</stentry> </strow> <strow> <stentry>Solid</stentry> <stentry>Red</stentry> <stentry>Ink level is critically low.</stentry> </strow> </simpletable> </refbody> </reference>

section.p: Result: <table> without merged cells or a <caption> maps to <simpletable>. <th> elements map to <sthead> and each <tr> maps to <strow>.
